mechanism_narrative: ERBB4 (RTK) and LIFR (cytokine receptor) forced proximity via flexible_GS4 linker (~20 Å) biases signaling toward GRB2-SHC1-RAS-MAPK, PI3K-AKT, and JAK-STAT pathways via transphosphorylation of shared adaptor docking sites, while sterically excluding PLCG1/PLCG2-mediated Ca2+ signaling. This biased output upregulates muscle structural/contractile genes (ACTA2, MYL9, MYH11, TAGLN) and downregulates aged-muscle IEGs (EGR1, FOS, JUN) and inflammatory markers (IL32, TXNIP), consistent with a rejuvenating transcriptional shift in aged myofibers.
